## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature you are proposing.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g., *"I'm always frustrated when..."*)

## 🔄 Alternative Considerations
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 👥 Target Stakeholder
- [ ] 🏠 Citizen / Household
- [ ] 🚛 Kabadiwala / Scrap Collector

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, mockups, or references here.
